name: Delta Air Lines
boundary: Equivalent gate service: 70% electric power + diesel cooling and 30% APU to 100% electric power + cooling; manufacturing and energy lifecycle included, end-of-life excluded
technology: Electric ground power and preconditioned air
summary: Aircraft can receive electricity and cooling at the gate instead of burning fuel. A lifecycle study supports large reductions at suitable gates; Delta’s remaining eligible gate activity is unmeasured.
formula: 1,000 matching baseline lifecycle tonnes × 63% = 630 tonnes; study range 630–970
opportunity: Finance additional gate power, cooling and reliable connection where fuel savings cover electricity, upkeep and capital.
constraints: 63% is the low endpoint across study cases, not a guaranteed Delta performance floor or a whole-airline reduction.
Match actual baseline use, including existing electric gate equipment. Exclude already completed or committed improvements from any new-funding claim; remaining eligible throughput is unknown.
Electricity mix, aircraft type, turnaround duration, weather, equipment availability and actual APU shutdown determine the result.
Preserve power supply, cabin thermal comfort and safe turnaround service. Revalidate lifecycle assumptions and infrastructure impacts for each project.
Scope 1 excludes Monroe refinery and separately reported biogenic CO₂; climate score excludes contrails and other aviation warming effects, pollution, water and biodiversity.
The 63–97% comparison starts with 70% electric ground power plus diesel cooling and 30% APU; it does not start with 100% APU use. End-of-life is excluded.
sources: Technology · Greer, Rakas & Horvath (2021), author institution abstract
Commercial funding precedent · FAA 2025 gate electrification guidance
Methods · Greer dissertation ch. 3, Tables 7–8 p. 45; Fig. 10 p. 53
steps: Identify a gate cohort with equivalent power and thermal-comfort service and measure use of existing equipment.
Match scenario 2b: 70% turnaround using electric ground power and diesel PCA, 30% APU; compare scenario 3a: electric power and electric PCA throughout.
Use the study’s low endpoint only as a conditional benchmark: 630 tonnes avoided per 1,000 matching lifecycle tonnes.
Identify actual remaining eligible activity before scaling; value the difference at $255.12 per tonne separately from financial cashflows.
